content.comment_body: How can I configure [product_name] so that it logs data only when a specific input is enabled? It seems the logger operates continuously, but I want it to activate only when a bit goes high, ideally from an input signal. There appear to be few resources on this feature so far. Thank you.
Hello, Please refer to the attached illustration. I hope this clarifies your question.
Thank you, I am not sure why I missed it earlier. Appreciate your help. Wishing you a great holiday season.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for a way to control when the data logging function on [product_name] activates, aiming for it to respond only to specific input signals rather than operating all the time. Due to the product being relatively new, there is not much community guidance yet. The user received prompt and useful assistance showing that targeted data logging is indeed possible with the right configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to configure the logger so it only collects data when a designated input signal is high, instead of running on a constant basis.
